description: ancestors.delete is dropped on frame pop, so a shared (DAG) object already visited under one key is treated as circular and silently skipped when encountered under a second key — no test exercises deepKeys with a shared sub-object referenced from two distinct paths
productionImpact: Any object graph where the same sub-object is referenced from two or more keys (a DAG) loses all keys under the second and subsequent references — deepKeys silently returns an incomplete list, so code that rebuilds a flat map from a live object (e.g. form serialisers, state differs, cache populators) silently drops fields and corrupts persisted data.
